verdict.rationale: The docs are published under distinct major-version paths (/v3/ and /v4/), and the AI-rules page targets 'Stagehand v4 code'. This implies a versioned SDK surface, but only through URL structure, not an explicit versioning policy. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, support windows, or a migration process. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit semantic-versioning or support-window commitments, v3→v4 migration/breaking-change guidance, independent corroboration of version stability.
